vetSays.line: 🛡️ Meera, Sean, Asma, Stepan and Jesse met them at the door — 5 put down. Meera, Sean, Asma, Stepan, Jesse are hurt.
🛡️ Meera and Olivia met them at the door — 2 put down. Meera, Olivia are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Sean, Asma, Stepan, Ruth and Oliver met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Asma, Stepan, Ruth, Oliver are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Harper just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Meera just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sean just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Harper, Meera, Sean, Stepan and Jesse met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Harper, Meera, Sean, Stepan, Jesse are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruth just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.
The Pack-leader Loud-Eyes wears a stranger's face. The face is too symmetrical. The eyes don't track you — they don't track anything.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Loud-Eyes (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Harper, Jesse. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader Loud-Eyes falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Loud-Eyes!
📺 You brought down Pack-leader Loud-Eyes, Loud-Eyes (packmate). (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Pack-leader Loud-Eyes, Loud-Eyes (packmate).
You catch Ruth telling the fire about Harper. "You brought down Pack-leader Loud-Eyes, Loud-Eyes (packmate)." The story's already growing.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nora just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Elijah and Nora met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off. Elijah, Nora are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
